about: The Hailstorm's own sounds. The voice is the half-track's flak gunner: a jumpy, wired young anti-air gunner, always watching the sky, on the vehicle radio; its lines go through comm.py like the others'. It is meant to be "Autocraft Hailstorm" (Voice Design, eleven_ttv_v3; the chosen preview was generated_voice_id GWzGO3H7fYDg7x7tLOZS), but the account was at its 10 custom voices, so for now it is the premade "Liam" (energetic young male); to switch, save the designed voice, set its id below and delete raw/vhailstorm_*.wav and raw/hailstormdeath_*.wav. Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>): vhailstorm = reports in, hailstormdeath = his cry as it blows up (the blast plays with it), flak = one burst of the twin flak guns (every 1.0 s, heard where the Hailstorm stands), flakhit = a flak shell bursting in the air at the flyer (Rules.flight after the shot), hailstormmove = a driven Hailstorm's engine as it pulls away (at most every 2 s, in your ear).

entries.text: [jumpy, fast] Hailstorm up! Eyes on the sky!
[wired, breathless] Guns up, guns up. Anything flies, it fries.
[nervous, quick] Did you hear that? Something's up there.
[twitchy, eager] Flak's loaded. Come on, birdie.

entries.prompt: twin anti-aircraft autocannons fire a quick burst upward: three heavy thumping pom-pom shots, punchy and metallic, brass clinking, close up, short tail
flak gun firing a short rapid burst at the sky, deep hollow thuds of heavy cannon rounds, mechanical clatter of the breech, close up
vehicle-mounted 40mm anti-air cannon, two quick booming shots in a row, sharp crack and hollow thump, ejected shell casings clanging
flak shell bursts in the air high overhead: a sharp cracking airburst explosion with shrapnel fizzing outward, short, at a distance
anti-aircraft round detonates in the sky, a dry punchy crack-boom with a short echo, fragments whistling, heard from below
proximity-fused flak explosion in midair, a hard crack and a puff, crackling shrapnel, brief rolling echo
armored half-track pulls away: heavy diesel engine revs up and growls, tank treads clank and squeak, front tyres crunching gravel, close up
military half-track accelerates from a standstill, gruff turbo-diesel roar rising through the revs, rattling tracks, heard from the driver's seat
sci-fi anti-air half-track guns its engine and rolls off, deep engine snarl and turbine whine, clattering steel tracks on dirt
